headline: Two tracks, one journey—how LEARN and GROW work together for complete development
universal_truth: Knowledge and skill develop together; knowing and doing reinforce each other
fun_facts: The LEARN track covers the world; the GROW track covers you
Both tracks are 365 days—a full year of each type of learning
Doing both daily creates synergy: knowledge informs skill, skill applies knowledge
discussion_questions: Do you prefer learning about the world or developing skills?
How do knowledge and practice reinforce each other for you?
Which track are you focusing on currently?

hook.script: Curious Kelly has two tracks: LEARN and GROW. They're designed to complement each other—one expands what you know, the other expands what you can do. Let me explain how they work together.

cliff.script: Why two tracks? Why not combine everything into one?

options.text: Different types of learning require different approaches—exploring ideas differs from building skills; separating them allows focused development of each, while doing both creates synergy
options.response: Exactly. The LEARN track sparks curiosity and expands understanding. The GROW track builds capability and metacognition. Together, they create well-rounded development.
One track provides value, but both together amplify each other. Knowledge without skill is untested; skill without knowledge is limited...

fact1.title: The LEARN Track
fact1.script: LEARN explores the world: science, philosophy, creativity, relationships. It builds curiosity about how things work. Each lesson expands what you know and how you think.

fact2.title: The GROW Track
fact2.script: GROW develops you: AI fluency, meta-learning, personal development. It builds capability and self-awareness. Each lesson makes you more effective at learning and living.

fact3.title: Using Both
fact3.script: You can focus on one track or do both daily. Doing both takes about 15-20 minutes total. The tracks reinforce each other: LEARN gives you knowledge to apply; GROW gives you skills to learn better.

wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Complete development combines knowing and doing. The LEARN and GROW tracks together create this balance. Use both for maximum benefit.

outro.script: Explore both tracks. Find your rhythm with each. They're designed to make you a more curious, capable, effective learner and human.

growTrack.title: Track Planning - Design Your Approach
growTrack.learning_objective: Create a plan for using both tracks
growTrack.activity: Decide your approach: Will you do both tracks daily? Alternate? Focus on one first? There's no wrong answer—design what works for your life and commitment level.
